name: pypsa-at
postCreateCommand: git fetch --unshallow && pixi run pre-commit install
postStartCommand: find /.jbdevcontainer/config/JetBrains -name '*.vmoptions' | xargs -I{} grep -lF 'Xmx' {} | xargs -I{} sh -c 'grep -qF "rd.transport.ping.timeout" "{}" || echo "-Drd.transport.ping.timeout.ms=60000" >> "{}"'
